main_measure.name: OLS slope of 5-bar forward excess return on forecast (non-overlapping grid)

statistic.name: OLS slope t, clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-bar return, top third of positive forecasts minus forecast 0

reading: excess return = 5-bar return minus the coin's mean 5-bar return on the non-overlapping grid of all its windows; slope from OLS with intercept and CR1 standard error clustered by UTC day; top third = positive-forecast grid bars at or above their 2/3 quantile; the plan's minimum counts, when not reached, give 'not observable'.
